## Summary

What does this PR change, in one or two sentences?

## Motivation

Why is this change worth making? Link to the issue if there is one.

## Roadmap check

Which phase does this belong to?

- [ ] v1.x Simple Mode polish
- [ ] v2 Power User Mode (gated behind toggle, off by default)
- [ ] v3 Proactive
- [ ] v4 Broader workloads
- [ ] None of the above — please discuss before merging

If "none of the above", explain why this should ship anyway and link to a ROADMAP.md update.

## Verification

- [ ] `make build` passes cleanly
- [ ] `make test` passes (no new failures)
- [ ] Manually exercised the changed behavior in the running app (not just the test suite)
- [ ] If UI: tested in both Modern and Terminal Green themes
- [ ] If classification: added a fixture test in `Tests/ProcessesTests/`

## Out-of-scope changes

PRs should be one logical change. If this bundles refactoring or lint, justify or split.
